fields.title: Prepare for an Event
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: A sale is in three weeks, expect a triple peak over two hours. Build a six-point checklist and state what numbers you provide.
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: numbers from PM — expected peak in RPS, ramp-up shape, scenario profile (browsing or checkout), date and duration. Checklist: peak calculation; verify external provider limits; load test at 150% with the correct profile; manually raise minimum instance count in advance; check feature flags and fallback priorities; on-call rotation. A common mistake is testing on an average profile: sales shift load to checkout and payment.
